items.title: Show HN: Multipeer, a multiplayer infinite canvas for people and their agents
items.contentSnippet:
I'm building Multipeer, a desktop app for running agents, tools and working wth teammates on one shared canvas.
I often have several agent sessions open at once, but they're all scattered across terminals. It was also hard for my co-founder to see what my agents are doing or jump in to work together. So We built the solution to our own problem. And now we're releasing it to the world.

items.title: Show HN: A map of outdoor gyms and pull-up bars
items.contentSnippet:
I've been training mostly outside for over a decade. I spent a decent amount of time in front of a screen, so it's usually a good opportunity to get some sun and fresh air.
I used https://calisthenics-parks.com/ for most of that time, but it was always slow and clunky. And then they took the site offline.
So, I built this: a map of 25k+ outdoor gyms, pull-up bars, and other exercise stations all over the world.
Maybe that's helpful to others.

items.title: Show HN: Web Bot Auth SDK and SSH Utilty
items.contentSnippet:
Launched a beta/buggy version of the SDK for web bot auth, and it's live at https://messh.io
Inspired by https://datatracker.ietf.org/wg/webbotauth/documents/
While solving this, I realized it solves the hassle of adding SSH keys, the overhead of copy-pasting n number of times to a remote server; just do
messh add amul
It will automatically search for Amul's public key and add it to my server
Do try if you find it interesting. But the main product aim is to solve web bot auth for agentic traffic
